content.short: Cede.store is now Cede Hub, a trade-to-earn platform where users join exchange campaigns and earn rewards.
content.description: Cede.store has evolved into Cede Hub, a trade-to-earn and hold-to-earn platform connecting token issuers with crypto traders. Users connect wallet and exchange accounts, choose live campaigns, trade eligible pairs through the Cede Hub interface, climb leaderboards, and receive rewards based on campaign rules. The platform is designed to create transparent trading competitions, boost token engagement, and distribute incentives to real participants. For Mantle ecosystem users, Cede Hub adds campaign-based trading rewards and market engagement tools around supported exchange activity.
content.meta: Cede.store, now Cede Hub, runs trading and holding campaigns with leaderboard rewards. Discover Cede.store on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
